_doc: Optional. Each anchor is one distinct capability written up in your evidence file (reference.md) that must have at least one bullet in data/bullet-library.json. A bullet covers an anchor when its text or keywords contain any of the anchor's terms (case insensitive). Checked by: node scripts/check-evidence-coverage.js (exit 1 on any uncovered anchor). When you add a capability to your evidence file, add a bullet AND an anchor. Leave anchors empty to skip the check. The _examples block is ignored by the script; copy its shape, not its content.
